data.name: Startup_Error_Message
data.value: Something went wrong while starting Lumen. Details were written to the log in %LOCALAPPDATA%\Lumen\logs.

data.name: Library_Empty
data.value: No games found yet. Lumen looks for Steam games installed on this PC; more stores and manual items are coming.

data.name: Library_ScanProblems
data.value: Some items from {0} could not be read. Details are in the log.

data.name: Library_ScanFailed
data.value: The library could not be scanned. Details are in the log.

data.name: Settings_Steam_Description
data.value: Add your Steam Web API key and SteamID64 to also see the games you own but haven't installed. The key is encrypted on this PC and is only sent to Steam.

data.name: Settings_Steam_SteamIdHint
data.value: The 17-digit number in steamcommunity.com/profiles/…. If your profile has a custom URL, you can find the number in Steam → Account details.

data.name: Settings_Steam_KeySavedHint
data.value: A key is saved. Leave this empty to keep it.

data.name: Settings_Steam_Private
data.value: Connected, but your game details are private, so Steam lists no games. In Steam, open your profile → Edit Profile → Privacy Settings and set Game details to Public.

data.name: Settings_Steam_InvalidKey
data.value: Steam rejected this key. Check it on the Steam API key page.

data.name: Settings_Steam_Unreachable
data.value: Couldn't reach Steam. Check your connection and try again.

data.name: Settings_Steam_InvalidSteamId
data.value: Enter a SteamID64 (17 digits starting with 7656119) or a steamcommunity.com/profiles/… URL.

data.name: Settings_Steam_MissingKey
data.value: Enter your Steam Web API key.

data.name: Settings_Steam_InvalidKeyFormat
data.value: That doesn't look like a Steam Web API key (32 letters and numbers).

data.name: Settings_Steam_Removed
data.value: Steam account details removed from this PC.
